propositions: A rejected tickets-branch auto-push succeeds locally but fails on the remote, with the rejection reason never surfaced to the caller, leaving the caller unaware of divergence and unpushed commits.
Ticket event payloads (especially comments containing environment output or credentials) are never scanned for secrets on write, only code is scanned by gitleaks at the review gate.
The regex _NON_FF over-broadly matches 'rejected' substring in policy-decline messages, misrouting terminal failures onto the retry path and skipping the stderr log that names the reason.
The PUSH_PENDING divergence signal is computed only during explicit `rebar fsck`, never during write operations, so a rejection that scrolls off screen leaves no escalating backlog signal.
On async push policy the failure is spawned detached with stderr redirected to DEVNULL, making the warning completely undeliverable to the writing caller.
